luther-preface-wisdom: Martin Luther, "Vorrede auff die Weisheit Salomonis" (Preface to the Wisdom of Solomon, 1534), in Biblia: das ist die gantze Heilige Schrifft Deudsch (Wittenberg, 1545), German text read at stilkunst.de
oesterley-wisdom: W. O. E. Oesterley, The Wisdom of Solomon, Translations of Early Documents, Series II: Hellenistic Jewish Texts (SPCK, 1918), introduction, with its reports of the commentaries of Eichhorn, Grimm, Gregg (1909), Goodrick (1913) and Toy, and of H. St. J. Thackeray, The Relation of St. Paul to Contemporary Jewish Thought (1900)
gigot-wisdom-ce: Francis Gigot, "Book of Wisdom," in The Catholic Encyclopedia, vol. 15 (Robert Appleton, 1912), read at newadvent.org
kohler-wisdom-je: Kaufmann Kohler, "Wisdom of Solomon, Book of the," in The Jewish Encyclopedia (1901–1906), read at jewishencyclopedia.com
usccb-wisdom-intro: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops, introduction to the Book of Wisdom in the New American Bible, Revised Edition (read at bible.usccb.org)
just-lectionary-index: Felix Just, S.J., index of the readings of the Catholic Lectionary for Mass for Sundays, feasts and the Masses for the Dead (2002 USA edition), at catholic-resources.org
oca-readings-tikhon: Orthodox Church in America, daily Scripture readings for 9 October 2019 (oca.org/readings), a day that commemorates the glorification of St. Tikhon of Moscow and the Apostle James son of Alphaeus
eotc-canon-list: Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, "The Canonical Books of the Holy Bible" (ethiopianorthodox.org), the church's list of its 46 Old Testament and 35 New Testament books
metzger-muratorian: Bruce M. Metzger's English translation of the Muratorian Fragment, from appendix IV of his The Canon of the New Testament (1987), with notes, at earlychristianwritings.com
jerome-preface-solomon: Jerome, Preface to the Books of Solomon, trans. Kevin P. Edgecomb (2006), at tertullian.org (the translation quoted here; the page says "All material on this page is in the public domain"); fourthcentury.com posts the same translation with the date "c. A.D. 398" and slightly different wording
winston-wisdom-ab: David Winston, The Wisdom of Solomon, Anchor Bible 43 (Doubleday, 1979), the publisher's description of the book, read at bestcommentaries.com
